prompt: We're building a Solid Pod for project management. We have markdown resources that come in four flavors: Project, Task, Milestone, Person. Each has its own SHACL shape and JSON-LD context. Right now they're distinguished only by `rdf:type` in the resource's `.meta` sidecar — but we want HTTP clients to be able to tell what kind of resource they're getting just from the HTTP response, without parsing the body. What's the right design? Give me example Turtle for one of the resource types (say Task) showing how the resource declares its kind, plus what HTTP response headers our server should emit.

assertions.name: uses_prof_vocabulary
assertions.description: Uses W3C PROF vocabulary (prof:Profile or prof:hasResource)
assertions.check: answer contains `prof:Profile` OR `prof:hasResource` OR references W3C PROF spec

assertions.name: class_iri_distinct_from_profile_iri
assertions.description: Distinguishes the class IRI (app:Task) from the profile IRI (separate resource)
assertions.check: answer explicitly mints a separate IRI for the profile, distinct from the class IRI; explains why they're not the same

assertions.name: instance_declares_both
assertions.description: Instance data shows both rdf:type AND dct:conformsTo
assertions.check: example Turtle for Task has `a app:Task` (or similar) AND `dct:conformsTo <…Profile>`

assertions.name: shape_as_artifact_not_profile
assertions.description: SHACL shape is wired as a prof:ResourceDescriptor with role:validation, not treated as the profile itself
assertions.check: answer shows shape via `prof:hasResource [ … prof:hasRole role:validation ; prof:hasArtifact <shape> ]`

assertions.name: no_content_profile_header
assertions.description: Does NOT recommend emitting Content-Profile header (lives only in expired IETF draft)
assertions.check: answer does not present Content-Profile as a recommended header (may mention it as deprecated/expired)

assertions.name: mentions_transitive_chain
assertions.description: Mentions prof:isTransitiveProfileOf for explicit chain emission OR avoids the at-risk axiom by other means
assertions.check: answer either uses prof:isTransitiveProfileOf or doesn't rely on dct:conformsTo chain inference

assertions.name: concrete_turtle_for_task
assertions.description: Provides concrete Turtle for the Task case as requested
assertions.check: answer includes a Turtle example specifically for a Task instance
